# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: one player walking into, round, onto and
# through another.
# bump spot=1132,-376,-151.875 yaw=0
# map mp_carentan, gametype probe_bump, walker team=allies weapon=m1carbine_mp, script bump
# client-probes/probe_bump under tools/run_probe.sh with +set probe_teleport 1 puts
# the target (axis, --probe-bump-target) on the spot and the walker (allies, this
# probe) 200 units behind it along -x, both facing +x. The recipe is in
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/README.md, probe_bump.
# Bump script, once per target stance (stand, crouch, prone), each started once the
# target's solid top byte has read the stance for 1000 ms: headon walks forward 2000 ms;
# back* walks back to the start mark 200 behind the target; glance-line moves
# 20 right (-y) of it; glance walks forward 2000 ms or until 50 past the
# target; jump-line moves to 40 behind the target's centre; jump holds
# forward and up from rest until landed; land stands 1500 ms.
# !cmd is a usercmd as it went on the wire (angles rebased on delta_angles), ms
# after the placement. !snap is the walker's playerstate per snapshot, stance from
# pm_flags, with the target's entity: target= its pos.trBase, target_vel its
# pos.trDelta, target_solid its packed solid. Floats are printed exactly.
# BROKEN stand/jump landed on 1022, not on the target
# the target's solid read 0 during crouch/jump (top byte Some(0), stance 82)
# BROKEN crouch/jump landed on 1022, not on the target
# the target's solid read 0 during prone/jump (top byte Some(0), stance 62)
# BROKEN prone/jump landed on 1022, not on the target
[phase settle]
